Public Sector Banks Show Strong Business Growth in Q2

Five public sector banks reported credit growth between 15% and 25% in the second quarter of the financial year 2027. This growth was driven by sustained demand for credit across agriculture, industry, services, and personal loans, according to the latest sectoral data from the Reserve Bank of India. Bank of India and Jammu & Kashmir Bank were specifically noted for posting strong business growth in the same quarter.
